projectDescription: A VST3/AudioUnit plugin that uses neural network models to accurately emulate guitar amplifiers and other audio hardware.
keyFeatures: VST3 and AudioUnit plugin formats for Windows and macOS
Loads neural network amp models (.nam files) for real-time guitar processing
Impulse Response (IR) loader for cabinet simulation
3-band tone stack (Bass, Mid, Treble) with enable/disable toggle
Input/output level controls with calibration support
Multiple output modes: Raw, Normalized, and Calibrated
Automatic sample rate resampling for models trained at different rates
Real-time input and output level meters
Standalone app mode in addition to plugin mode
publicApiSurface: Parameters: Input Level, Output Level, Bass, Mid, Treble, Noise Gate Threshold, Noise Gate Active, EQ Active, IR Toggle, Calibrate Input, Input Calibration Level, Output Mode
Model file format: .nam (JSON-based neural amp model files)
IR file format: .wav (impulse response files for cabinet simulation)
ResamplingNAM: resampling wrapper for NAM DSP models
